column1: # Labelled messages for tuning the ScamLens rules (dev split). Rules may be tuned against this file.
# Columns: id, label (scam|legit), language (en|hi|mr|hinglish|mixed), text. "\n" in text means a line break.
# Written for CyberShield in the style of scams described in public advisories (RBI, NPCI, CERT-In, I4C, state police)
# and of ordinary Indian SMS/WhatsApp traffic. They are not copies of real messages; phone numbers and links are fictitious.
